attributes.law_screen: claim.law.single-file-attempt-overflow n/a. claim.law.single-use-field-pointer-alias-is-folded-away.20260831.v1 APPLIED and CONFIRMED by measurement: the probe introduced `u8* scan = state + off;` specifically to force the target's `add` + displaced `lwz` pair, and MWCC folded the single-use alias straight back into an indexed `lwzx` - so a declared alias is NOT sufficient to defeat indexed addressing when it has exactly one use, and the counter-form must give the alias a second consumer. claim.law.multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing.20260830.v2 SCREENED as the counter-form for the next session (it names the multi-field-alias shape that does defeat lwzx). claim.law.if-else-arm-swap-controls-fallthrough-placement.20260831.v1 and claim.law.guard-polarity-restructure-fixes-count-parity-not-form.20260831.v1 SCREENED and directly relevant to the remaining branch-polarity clusters (target bge/b two-destination pair vs our single blt); the latter's warning that polarity restructuring fixes COUNT parity rather than FORM is exactly what this probe observed. claim.law.insn-count-parity-outranks-local-opcode-fidelity.20260831.v1 APPLIED to arbitrate the result: the probe improved local opcode fidelity (multiset 16t -> 14t) but broke count parity (167/167 -> 167/165), and by this law that is a REGRESSION, so it was reverted. claim.law.sizeof-defeats-loop-stride-induction.20260831.v1 SCREENED, no sizeof stride substitution was made. claim.law.webfrank-pinned-function-source-freeze.20260831.v1 SCREENED: game/audio/audio has no pinned functions.
attributes.residual: THE PARK'S CLASSIFICATION WAS WRONG AND THIS RECORD CORRECTS IT. attempt.parked.audioloadpart.20260829.v1 (a legacy bulk import) filed this as 'REGISTER_ONLY/SCHEDULE (allocator or scheduler residual), residual survived the recorded flag/pragma/compiler sweeps'. It is not: at 167/167 instructions and real 162 (fuzzy 75.66%, the lowest-scoring function in all three TUs of this lane), `fndiff --ops` reports opcode multiset DIFFERS by 16 tokens with a clean structural signature - target-only +2 add +2 b +1 beq +2 bge +1 lwz, ours-only -2 blt -2 bne -1 cmpw -1 cmpwi -2 lwzx. Two named, source-reachable defect families, both verified against the target disassembly: (A) INDEXED-vs-DISPLACED LOADS at two sites. At +0x64 target forms the pointer then loads with a displacement (`add r4,r31,r3` / `lwz r0,1176(r4)`) while ours folds the constant into the index (`addi r0,r3,1176` / `lwzx r0,r31,r0`); identically at +0xc4 target has `add r3,r5,r28` / `lwz r0,28(r3)` where ours has `addi r0,r3,28` / `lwzx r0,r5,r0`. The target also keeps partIdx*4 in a persistent register (r28, `slwi r28,r22,2`) rather than recomputing it into a scratch. (B) LOOP-EXIT CONTROL FLOW in the free-slot scan. Target runs a ctr-counted loop of 4 whose body branches `bge`-to-continue / `b`-to-found, falls through to a `li r29,-1` sentinel, and lands on the shared `cmpwi r29,0` - i.e. the found path GOTOs past the sentinel assignment. Ours instead breaks out and then re-tests the counter (`cmpwi r29,4` / `blt`). PROBE RESULT (AXIS1, the (B) fix): rewriting the loop as `for (slot = 0, off = slot; slot < 4; slot++, off += 36) { ... goto found; } slot = -1; found:` removed the spurious post-loop counter test and improved the opcode multiset 16t -> 14t, confirming the target's control-flow shape is correctly identified, BUT dropped the instruction count to 165 against target 167 and moved real 162 -> 186, so it was reverted under the count-parity law. The 2-instruction deficit it exposed is REAL and pre-existing, and it localizes the next work: the reconstruction is short by ~2 instructions in the sndCmd4 queue-slot setup region, where target +0x180-0x1a4 holds nine instructions (addi, addi, stw, li, lis, stw, stw, lwz, addi) against our five (lis, stw, addi, li, stw), and again at +0x204-0x214 (target li, stw, li, bl) and +0x21c-0x228 (target beq, li, b vs our single bne). WORK ORDER for the next session: reconstruct the queue-slot setup and the retry/response arms FIRST to recover count parity, THEN re-apply the (B) goto shape (which is already proven correct), THEN fix the two (A) lwzx sites using a multi-use alias rather than the single-use alias that MWCC folds away. This function should not be re-parked as allocator noise.
